name: io.github.tevfikefeaydin/agenttoll
description: 21 paid data tools plus free quote/budget inspection, with bounded USDC payments on Base.

environmentVariables.name: AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional paying-wallet EVM private key; omit for free quote/budget inspection.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTTOLL_URL
environmentVariables.description: API origin (default https://agenttoll.app); custom origins require AGENTTOLL_RECIPIENT.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTTOLL_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: Payment network: base (default) or base-sepolia. Base data always uses mainnet.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTTOLL_RECIPIENT
environmentVariables.description: Trusted receiving address; required for a custom API origin.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTTOLL_BUDGET_USDC
environmentVariables.description: Finite session USDC budget (default 1); maximum six decimal places.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTTOLL_MAX_PER_CALL_USDC
environmentVariables.description: Optional lower USDC ceiling; registered endpoint prices remain the upper limit.
